notes: Do not use collage as Airbnb cover photo during this test. Pool/lake must say Access because these are shared Emerald Lakes HOA/community amenities. Review after at least two Airbnb diagnostic cycles. Merged supporting changes: listing title update and hot tub hero/photo-sequence strategy.

new_value: Updated LOS pricing to 1 night +15%, 2 nights -5%, 3 nights -10%, 4+ nights -15%. Kept same-day/last-minute premium separate at +10% for current-day booking.
reason: Current no-cleaning-fee strategy appeared strong for 1-night bookings but may have overfavored cleaning-heavy short stays and created multi-night price friction.
expected_effect: Originally expected to increase 2-3 night booking share, improve revenue per cleaning, reduce unnecessary turnover pressure, and support $100K annual pace without switching immediately to a fixed cleaning fee.
guardrails: Track as a PriceLabs test only; do not let Airbnb diagnostics create automatic PriceLabs rule recommendations.
notes: Superseded by competitiveness_booking_friction_test after LOS was changed again and additional booking-friction settings were updated: extra guest fee threshold, pet fee, and Instant Book eligibility.

old_value: Extra guest fee after 6 guests; LOS pricing 1 night +15%, 2 nights -5%, 3 nights -10%, 4+ nights -15%; pet fee $75; Instant Book limited by good guest track record.
new_value: Extra guest fee after 10 guests; LOS pricing 1 night +5%, 2 nights 0%, 3 nights -5%, 4+ nights -15%; pet fee effectively removed with $5 placeholder; Instant Book good guest track record requirement turned off.
reason: Airbnb listing-to-booking conversion was weak while wishlist activity and listing interest were meaningful. Total price, guest-count pricing, pet fee, and Instant Book eligibility may have made the listing look less competitive after guests clicked.
expected_effect: Improve listing-to-booking conversion, booking completion, 7-10 guest competitiveness, pet-search competitiveness, and 1-3 night booking value while protecting 4+ night revenue efficiency.
primary_success_metrics: listing_to_booking_conversion_rate; search_to_listing_conversion_rate; wishlist_additions; booked_nights; ADR; revenue_per_cleaning; avg_LOS; booking_count
guardrails: Do not lower base/min price during this test. Do not add a cleaning fee during this test. Airbnb diagnostics are diagnostic only; PriceLabs recommendations still require PriceLabs revenue, occupancy, ADR, and cleaning-efficiency data.
notes: This test changed several booking-friction settings at once, so evaluate only after at least two weekly cycles. Watch guest quality, pet-related cleaning/damage risk, revenue per cleaning, and whether ADR drops too much. If conversion improves but revenue per cleaning weakens, consider restoring protection gradually: 1-night LOS to +10%, extra guest fee after 8, or a modest pet fee.
